item.title: Daltoniana Autumn issue
item.description: Nov 5th. The latest issue of Daltoniana (#126) has just been emailed out to to all who requested it via your GDPR permissions. If you haven't received a copy, please send a message via the contact page. Daltoniana issues 1-125 are available from this website for download.

item.title: Ljubljana Proceedings
item.description: We're pleased to announce that the colour vision feature issue of JOSA A has been mailed out to all ICVS members. These include the proceedings of the last meeting, held in Ljubljana in 2024.

item.title: Verriest Medallist 2026
item.description: The 2026 Verriest Medal will be awarded to Professor Keiji Uchikawa at the 28th Symposium of the International Colour Vision Society (ICVS) to be held at the University of Sussex in Brighton in 2026. The award was established in 1991 in memory of the founder of the Society, Dr. Guy Verriest, and honours outstanding contributions in the field of colour vision.

item.title: Smith-Pokorny Award 2026
item.description: We are pleased to announce that the recipient of the first Smith-Pokorny Award (2026) is Dr. Takuma Morimoto. The award, which was established by ICVS to recognise scientists at an early stage of their careers, was named in honour of the outstanding contributions of Vivianne C. Smith and Joel Pokorny to the field of colour vision.
